title: Kappa Records and Raymond Burke
summary: Allen recalls the Kappa label; Riddick tells how Raymond Burke played with them when Lester Bouchon was ill, and how Burke wiggled.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
